hero.description: Fullstack Software Development Intern at Just. Exploring how engineering, artificial intelligence and business come together to build useful products.

work.title: Things I've built.
work.subtitle: Real work across analytics, digital products and game development.
work.analytics: Digital analytics dashboard for Just, bringing GA4, Microsoft Clarity and Zoho PageSense into one experience, with collection health monitoring and period comparisons.
work.barber: Barbershop booking and management platform with reservations, services, scheduling, team, clients and an admin dashboard. Built with a Next.js frontend and API integration.
work.academic: Academic projects and studies using Java and Spring Boot.
work.minddrop: A collaborative arcade game built in C with Raylib, featuring boss battles, projectiles, power-ups and number-guessing challenges. My contributions included projectile firing and attribute drops.

about.title: Curiosity into craft.
about.description: My journey in software development has taken me through Estácio, where I studied with a ProUni scholarship, CESAR School and now Just, a legal technology company. I care about building useful software and understanding the problems behind it.

process.title: Engineering with AI in the loop.
process.description: I explore AI-assisted development workflows, including orchestrating specialized agents to collaborate on development tasks. The goal is to combine engineering judgment with new ways of building.
process.note: Conceptual illustration of my approach — not an internal system diagram.

experience.title: Tools are a means. Impact is the goal.

contact.title: Let's build something meaningful.
contact.description: Interested in software engineering, AI and products that solve real problems.

signature.title: Creation is connection.
signature.description: Software, artificial intelligence and design are not isolated disciplines. They come together to turn ideas into experiences that make sense — and actually work.
